page_title: WOL 2-4 WER | Wolfsburg v Werder Bremen 20/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Half-chance! Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) plays a pass into the box, but Kamil Grabara reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90+8' Werder Bremen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+8' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Kamil Grabara to get hold of the ball. Werder Bremen will take a corner kick.
90+7' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot.
90+6' There's an opportunity for Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

90+6' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Werder Bremen earn a corner.
90+5' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) replaces Marvin Ducksch.
90+3' A wild pass somehow finds Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
90+1' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Michael Zetterer, who smothers the ball.
87' Salih Ozcan (Wolfsburg) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
87' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
84' Substitution. Marco Grull is replaced by Keke Topp (Werder Bremen).
84' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Julian Malatini is replaced by Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen).
84' The manager makes a subsitution with Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) coming on for Felix Agu.
82' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is out of play. Werder Bremen will have a throw-in.
81' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Kamil Grabara, who makes a comfortable save.

79' 2 - 4 Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) scores a goal! He makes his way to the edge of the box without any help from his teammates and unleashes a shot that ends in the right side of the goal, bouncing in off the post.
78' Substitution. Jonas Wind makes his way off the pitch and Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) comes on as his replacement.
78' Werder Bremen can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
72' 1 - 4 Goal! Marvin Ducksch plays it to Marco Grull (Werder Bremen), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Kamil Grabara. 1:4.
71' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He creates some space for the shot, but blazes it high over the crossbar. Very bad attempt.
68' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) cannot believe that he has been told to leave the field of play after the referee blows his whistle and sends him off!

67' 1 - 3 Mitchell Weiser sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:3.
66' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
65' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
65' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) replacing Ridle Baku.
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is replacing Konstantinos Koulierakis.
62' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
61' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) sends a cross into the box, but Michael Zetterer comes off his line to gather the ball.
59' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) tackles a bit over-zealously and Daniel Schlager blows for a foul.
55' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
51' 1 - 2 Goal! Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:2.

51' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the middle of the goal, but Kamil Grabara pulls off a great save to deny him.
51' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.

50' Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
48' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' 1 - 1 Goal! Marvin Ducksch puts a cross into the box and finds Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the roof of the net. He makes it 1:1.
45+5' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

45+4' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
45+3' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
45+3' Daniel Schlager blows the whistle, Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) is penalised for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Wolfsburg.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Michael Zetterer easily makes the save.
42' Ralph Hasenhuttl is forced to make a change. Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is unable to continue due to injury, Yannick Gerhardt comes on.
42' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) will miss the next game.
42' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) picks up a yellow card.
41' What a sweet touch by Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Michael Zetterer to hold.
39' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
38' Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) is penalised for holding. Daniel Schlager signals a set piece. Wolfsburg are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

37' Michael Zetterer makes a brilliant save! Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
36' A player from Wolfsburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
35' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) will take a corner kick.
35' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
33' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
32' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
31' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
28' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
28' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
26' The referee blows his whistle after Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
24' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
24' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. Good work from Wolfsburg as they win a corner.
24' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
23' Ole Werner is forced to make a change. Anthony Jung is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen).
22' The foul by Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) was seen by Daniel Schlager who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
21' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
19' 1 - 0 Goal 1:0! Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
19' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
19' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
19' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' The free kick into the penalty area from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
16' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
13' Great solo effort from Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rose just over the bar.
10' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniel Schlager signals.
7' Wonderful movement by Werder Bremen. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
5' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Marvin Ducksch, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
5' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

4' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
1' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen), but Kamil Grabara is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Daniel Schlager.
